metaTitle: Custom Cotton Work Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom cotton work shirts for your team. Breathable, durable, and perfect for embroidery or screen printing.
introHtml: Cotton work shirts offer a classic, breathable option for teams that need comfort during long shifts. Unlike synthetic blends, cotton fabrics like denim, oxford cloth, and wrinkle-resistant weaves provide a professional look that holds up to repeated washing. Whether you choose a rugged flannel from Carhartt or a crisp Oxford from Brooks Brothers, these shirts accept embroidery and screen printing cleanly, making them ideal for company logos on uniforms or promotional giveaways.
heroAltText: Custom cotton work shirts with embroidered logo, available in denim and oxford styles
